clusters.name: Your sister Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Within about a year and a half of your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, you said your mother Lena felt worn out and on edge by August 1995, your parents grew distant by November 1995, you had stomach aches and missed school from February 1996, your father and Jonah had shouting matches in May 1996, and your mother did not return to her job by September 1996, all held as a guess around the birth. Nothing further is told until 2003, when you moved to the city for college, marking where things had settled.
